title: Austin's Natural Gas Power Play
summary:
*   Austin began seeking a natural gas supply to fuel the city's electrical generating system.
*   Multiple companies, including some from Texas and Oklahoma, submitted bids detailing their proposed gas prices.
*   All received bids were immediately turned over to an external consulting firm for thorough evaluation, with a final decision to be made later.
